blocks.text:
After breakfast, visit the Brazilian side of the falls.

Iguazu consists of many separate cascades that plunge into the river canyon. The name comes from the Guarani language and means “big water”. The complex has 275 cascades.

The walking trail gradually leads to the viewpoints. The main highlight is Devil’s Throat, where the water falls with particular force and the air is constantly filled with spray. The Brazilian side offers a clear view of the extent of the cascades and the curve of the gorge.
